title: Emojis as Anchors to Detect Arabic Offensive Language and Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Manual annotation of emoji-anchored offensive tweets to categorize gender-directed hate speech, followed by word valence score analysis to identify common gender-specific target terms.

Manual annotation of tweets to identify hate speech based on race, ethnicity, or nationality, along with extracting common target terms (e.g., specific countries or ethnic groups) using valence scores.
Categorizing tweets for religion-based hate speech and quantifying the distribution of hateful tweets targeted toward specific religious groups (e.g., Jews, Muslims, Christians, Shia).
Annotating offensive tweets for hate speech based on ideology and using statistical valence scoring to extract targeted political parties and factional groups.
Human annotation of collected offensive tweets to identify and measure the prevalence of hate speech targeting social class.
Human annotation of collected offensive tweets to identify and measure the prevalence of hate speech targeting disabilities or diseases.
